text:
eval-bot: Nightly eval alert: sparkline token-stutter detected for model redwood-llama-3-int4 on cohort 'support-qa-short' — 22% accuracy drop vs baseline, bursty repeated tokens between token positions 3-8. Severity: P2. Links: https://ci.internal/evals/5511 (logs + diffs)

maria (ML/Onboard): Heads up — failing cohort affects a high-volume promptset. Can we triage quickly? @jon @kevin

kevin (eval): Replayed the failing traces locally, repros on int4 but not on fp16. Repro command:```bash
./replay_eval --model redwood-llama-3-int4 --cohort support-qa-short --seed 42 --out replay.tar.gz
```Stutter shows as repeated token sequences like "the the the" or sequences of <pad>.

sasha (eng): Could be a KV cache alignment issue after quantized kernel switch. We've seen repeating outputs when cache pointers aren't reset between partial-prefix batches.

jon (infra): Looking at runtime logs for dedicated pool id=prod-gpu-pool-3: saw a batch upsert error (batch id 8421) right at 03:12 UTC: "kv_index_mismatch". Pushing a hotfix to verify KV shape before reuse, will patch in 10m and drain in-flight requests.

maria (ML/Onboard): If hotfix holds, can we route hosted traffic to fp16 variant meanwhile? Risk avoidance > cost. @kevin can you prepare a canary rollback?

kevin (eval): Preparing a canary rollout config:```json
{ "route": "hosted", "from": "redwood-llama-3-int4", "to": "redwood-llama-3-fp16", "pct": 100, "reason": "token-stutter regression" }
```Will also kick a re-eval comparing int4 vs fp16 with same seeds.

eval-bot: Re-eval job queued: 5512 (fp16 vs int4), estimated finish ~23m. Artifacts will attach here.

sasha (eng): Also recommend running a quick prompt-length sweep: short (<40 tokens) vs long (40-120) — symptoms seem prefix-length dependent in the replay.

jon (infra): Hotfix deployed to 3/5 hosts in that pool. Observability: token-stutter metric dropped ~90% on patched hosts within 2 minutes. Rolling to remaining hosts now.

maria (ML/Onboard): Owners: infra -> @jon, eval -> @kevin, model lead -> @sasha. Severity set to P2 (ongoing monitoring). Immediate actions: 1) route hosted -> fp16 (canary), 2) patch remaining hosts, 3) run eval job 5512 and prompt-length sweep, 4) prepare rollback comms for customers if needed.

kevin (eval): I'll upload replay.tar.gz + trace logs and open an RFC for kernel/quant-kernel changes. Will link PR and eval artifacts here.

maria (ML/Onboard): Thanks team. Once we have re-eval numbers, we'll decide whether to resume int4 canary with additional KV-guards. :thumbsup:

jon (infra): Will follow up in 30m with host patch status and whether any traffic was impacted during drain.

kevin (eval): 5512 finished (fp16 vs int4): fp16 baseline stable, int4 shows 21% stutter regression on same cohort. Attaching summary: https://ci.internal/evals/5512/summary

maria (ML/Onboard): Ok — keep int4 off public traffic until kernel fix + KV tests. Closing initial triage, moving to follow-up RFC and action-tracking.
